Your AI Persona

Nine scenario-based questions that map your cognitive relationship with AI: how you think alongside it, how it shapes your professional identity, and whether it has changed what good PMM work means to you. Based on the Artificiality Institute's Cognitive Sovereignty research.

What you'll learn

The 10x PMM Scorecard
